findings.text: `audit_session` must not be in the rewrite list in `Servex/ext/remote/RemoteMCP.js` `intercept()` (the `/^(session_summary|session_line|quick_fix|audit_session)$/` line). Its `session` argument is a Claude session uuid, and those are never in `servex.sessions.map`, so every call from the voice app gets its uuid swapped for the `v-` voice id and audits nothing. Keep the rewrite for the tools that take a `v-` id: `session_summary`, `session_line` and `quick_fix`.

The brief asked for "the day's voice session", but `voice_session()` makes a new session for each MCP connection (keyed by `mcp-session-id`). Every time the Claude app reconnects, the day gets another `v-…` folder. That may be the better choice, but `doc/voice-logging.md` should say it was chosen on purpose.

The test's fake `sessions.create` (`RemoteMCP.test.mjs`, the `servex` stub) writes no line 1, so the test only checks the fallback header written by `RemoteMCP.js`. The real `Sessions.create` writes its own line 1 without `caller`, so `lines[0].session.caller === "voice-app"` passes here but would not be true in production. Also, `row.caller` is set after `store.save()`, so it is not saved until something else saves.
`Sessions.create({ path: "/live/" })` calls `point()`, which posts a "started" line on `/live/` for every new connection. Check whether that is wanted on the owner's presentation screen.
In `record()` in `RemoteMCP.js`, the `catch {}` hides a failed write, so a lost owner line would leave no trace. Log it with `console.error`, as `voice_session()` already does.

Plan steps 4 and 5 have no evidence in the diff. Step 4: does `/live/sessions/` list the folder? Step 5: the smoke test on a private port, and a `Note:` card about the Servex restart. The doc says the work is "live after a Servex restart".

There is no `requirements.md` in the task folder, so this review used the brief in `Servex/ext/remote/doc/voice-logging.md` (its Plan, items 1–5). That brief was met: `owner_words` is on every schema and removed before dispatch, the words are saved once per distinct text with no length cut, every call is logged with an args hash, and the files that belonged to another task were not touched. `node Servex/ext/remote/RemoteMCP.test.mjs` in the worktree prints `ok 7 calls`.

`register_session` still advertises `required: ["id", "session_id"]` (Servex/agents/External.js:156, and `RemoteMCP.tools()` passes `required` through unchanged), but the new INSTRUCTIONS line in Servex/ext/remote/RemoteMCP.js:19 says "no arguments needed". A client that checks the schema, or a model that follows it, sends an `id`. Then `!target.id` in `intercept()` is false, the call goes to `External.register`, and it registers an external agent instead of returning the `v-` voice session. Fix: drop `required` for this tool in `tools()`, or have `intercept()` answer every `register_session` call that has no live `session_id`.

Servex/ext/remote/doc/voice-logging.md, Status line: it still says `audit_session` with a missing or unknown `session` gets the voice id. Round 1's fix took `audit_session` out of the code (`/^(session_summary|session_line|quick_fix)$/`), so the doc is now stale.

The real `Sessions.create` (Servex/agents/Sessions.js:710) writes line 1 itself, with `kind:"voice"` but no `caller`. So `RemoteMCP.voice_session()`'s own `{session:{…caller:"voice-app"}}` header is never written in production, and the test passes only because its stub `create()` writes nothing (RemoteMCP.test.mjs, the `servex.sessions` stub). The `caller` is still saved on the store row, so this is minor. Either make the stub write a line 1 like the real one does, or drop the `lines[0].session.caller` assertion.

`Sessions.create({ path: "/live/" })` calls `point()` (Sessions.js:711), which posts a "started" presence line on `/live/`'s folder for every new MCP connection. `/live/` is the voice agent's presentation screen, so check whether it should show those lines (round-1 note 4, still open).

Round 1's other points are fixed: the `catch` in `record()` now logs with `console.error`, `row.caller` is set before `store.save?.()`, and the doc says one session per connection is on purpose. Plan steps 4 and 5 still have no evidence in the diff: no check that `/live/sessions/` lists the `v-` folder, and no `Note:` card about the Servex restart.

This review had no `requirements.md` in the task folder, so it used the Plan in Servex/ext/remote/doc/voice-logging.md (items 1–3 are met by the diff and the test). The diff changes no page and has no shots, so only Requirements and Words were checked.
